Chapter 45: A good declaring of some certain deceits that may befall in this work. episodes.title: The Cloud of Unknowing: Week 1—Chapter 1-4
episodes.short: The Cloud of Unknowing: Week 1—Chapter 1-4
episodes.description: Welcome to Week One of The Cloud of Unknowing. Our program features an extended interview with John Polhamus, the narrator of this new recording. He offers insight into his interpretive approach, the historical and spiritual texture of the text, and the enduring relevance of its teachings. Following the conversation, Mr. Polhamus delivers a reading of Chapters 1 through 4, in which the anonymous author lays the foundation for a life of contemplative discipline, rooted in humility.

episodes.title: Day 28: Coda — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Coda — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… A wrap up and review of our book!

episodes.title: Day 27: Pt V Ch 7 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt V Ch 7 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How we should prepare our meditations the night before What to do if you awake during the night How to place yourself in the presence of God How to position one’s body in prayer Not to pass too quickly to new points in meditation How to examine one’s prayer

episodes.title: Day 26: Pt V Ch 6 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt V Ch 6 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How your own reflections are more valuable than hearing others In Affections we should show respect to God We must be generous and courageous in prayer seeking union of love with God If neither consolation nor desolation occur, serious examination is a must It is important not to cut short prayer time, especially when experiencing desolation If you are attracted to something inordinately put all your strength into the contrary

episodes.title: Day 25: Pt V Ch 3-5 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt V Ch 3-5 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How to use the five sense in prayer About the “Second Method” of prayer: weighing the meaning of each word in prayer About the “Third Method” of prayer: breathing between each word in vocal prayer

episodes.title: Day 24: Pt V Ch 2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt V Ch 2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How Contemplation is a visit to our Lord in one of the Mysteries of His life About the Use of 3 Preludes About the Use of 3 Points How to include the prepatory prayer and colloquy

episodes.title: Day 23: Pt V Ch 1 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt V Ch 1 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About Active Contemplation That it’s a type of meditation That it is based on peace, adoration, and love That it’s focus is on stirring up love for God

episodes.title: Day 22: Pt IV Ch 6 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt IV Ch 6 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear about not being able to follow a course of reasoning because… A person has limited mental capacity Ill health A person is naturally given to warm affections That person is actually in Affective Prayer

episodes.title: Day 21: Pt IV Ch 3-5 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt IV Ch 3-5 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… When we feel weary in prayer we should remember that we do not pray for “Spiritual Delights” When we feel discouraged we should remember that the Holy Spirit sometimes delays before visiting the soul in prayer, and how we need to be patient If we struggle with meditation, a book or a Spiritual Director can be helpful.

episodes.title: Day 20: Pt IV Ch 1-2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt IV Ch 1-2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How we shouldn’t be surprised by distractions That usually we just need to return to the subject of the meditation That when distractions are especially severe we can make acts of faith, hope, charity, adoration, petition, etc. How dryness can be caused by lack of vigor or as a trial That there are two kinds of dryness: intermittent and continuous Suggestions from St. Ignatius’ Discernment of Spirits

episodes.title: Day 19: Pt III Ch 3-4 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt III Ch 3-4 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How ordinary prayer must have acts of the intellect and will, or at least the will, to be fruitful About raising one’s heart to God throughout the day Tips on dryness for prayer throughout the day

episodes.title: Day 18: Pt III Ch 2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt III Ch 2 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About the 4 advantages of Affective Prayer: Abundant Spiritual Consolation It gives us a high idea of the perfection of God It leads to union of our will to God’s It gives fervor for all things connected with God’s service About 4 precautions about using Affective Prayer before we receive the grace to do so: Our faults are still corrected with difficulty Solid virtue has not been acquired We still struggle to banish human ideas for the Divine perspective We remain cold in our affections

episodes.title: Day 17: Pt III Ch 1 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt III Ch 1 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… That Affective Prayer comes after the practice of Meditation How it has an emphasis on the will How it greatly shortens the time spent in consideration That acts of adoration, praise, oblation, etc. come easily in Affective Prayer How in it, resolutions form spontaneously as opposed to as a result of reflection How it is a grace That the soul in Affective Prayer still experiences distractions and the means to dealing with them How souls will not always be able to make this type of prayer

episodes.title: Day 16: Pt II Ch 27-30 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 27-30 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How the entire surrender of ourselves to God is the perfection towards which we ought to strive during life Of two motives for oblation: justice and love About Affections: giving thanks for our meditation, offering our resolutions, and asking for the grace to fulfill them About making a reflection on our prayer, which includes an examination and recapitulation What are the best time, length, place, and body position for prayer

episodes.title: Day 15: Pt II Ch 25-26 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 25-26 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear about 4 ways of praying: Asking God for particular graces Prayer to God in a general manner Offering God motives to hear our prayer Making No Request Also the circumstances when petition is fitting: When urged by the Holy Spirit to ask for a particular grace With Spiritual Consolation With Spiritual Desolation When about to do something “important for God”

episodes.title: Day 14: Pt II Ch 23-24 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 23-24 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How prayer must be humble, confident, and persistent How prayer for temporal favors is good but not infallible

episodes.title: Day 13: Pt II Ch 21-22 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 21-22 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How to give thanks in both joy and suffering About Prayer properly so-called or “petition” About A.C.T.S - Adoration, Contrition, Thanksgiving, and Supplication

episodes.title: Day 12: Pt II Ch 19-20 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 19-20 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How we should make acts of pure love, benevolence, and friendship Jesus The difference between love and benevolence About the sorrowing love of Contrition

episodes.title: Day 11: Pt II Ch 17-18 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 17-18 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear how God is our best friend and also the best of fathers… His pleasure is our own We take more pleasure in him than anything we own We console Him We have confidence in Him

episodes.title: Day 10: Pt II Ch 15-16 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 15-16 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… Of how all our surroundings speak of God’s love and invite us to return that love How we can show this love especially in suffering On considering the title of “Creator and Sovereign Lord”

episodes.title: Day 9: Pt II Ch 12-14 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 12-14 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How charity is a friendship with God, that takes the form of mutual love How we must love God above all things Of the three levels of love of God: Not wanting to commit Mortal Sin, Venial Sin, and Semi-Deliberate Venial Sin About Affective vs Effective Love of God

episodes.title: Day 8: Pt II Ch 10-11 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 10-11 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How love, unlike hope, involves disinterested love (not for any reward) How it goes beyond just wanting what is best for God How it adds a desire for union with God, a union of heart and will

episodes.title: Day 7: Pt II Ch 8-9 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 8-9 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How acts of the will are more important than the intellect About Hope as an “interested love” About Hope as a confidence that we shall be with God for all eternity

episodes.title: Day 6: Pt II Ch 6-7 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 6-7 — The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How the memory is used in prayer How the intellect (understanding) is used in prayer About making Acts of Faith

episodes.title: Day 5: Pt II Ch 3-5 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 3-5 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About adoration and humility How to ask Grace of the Holy Spirit What is the sensitive appetite

episodes.title: Day 4: Pt II Ch 1-2 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Pt II Ch 1-2 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How to prepare the night before About purifying the intention of our prayer About choosing the subject for our meditation How to prepare a subject How to place yourself in the presence of God

episodes.title: Day 3: Ch 4-5 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Ch 4-5 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About the joys and fruits of prayer—peace, hope, and love How the apostolic worker becomes an instrument of God by prayer How “The pains and sufferings of life on earth are the gold which the infinite happiness of heaven is bought”

episodes.title: Day 2: Ch 1-3 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Ch 1-3 —The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… Definitions of colloquy, memory, intellect, will, purgitive, illuminative, and unitive About the excellence of prayer How prayer obtains salvation How prayer enriches us with merits How prayer leads to Christian perfection

episodes.title: Day 1: Preface—The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.short: Preface—The Practice of Mental Prayer
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… A little bit about the author Fr. René De Maumigny, S.J. What it is to be a Tertian Master About the five parts that make up the book

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 28~Oblation
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 28~Oblation
episodes.description: In today’s episode we pray the Act of Oblation of Myself as a Victim of Holocaust to Merciful Love. See oratepress.com/resources/oblation for a PDF of the oblation.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 27~Ch 9 § 3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 27~Ch 9 § 3
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear about the two ways of practicing penance… Recourse to extraordinary means The opportunities which present themselves daily

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 26~Ch 9 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 26~Ch 9 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How the nearer we are to God the simpler we become How St. Thérèse focused on the Gospels as her book of choice About the simplicity of the Holy Family’s life How we should base our virtue on the “perfect fulfillment of the duties of our state”

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 25~Ch 9 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 25~Ch 9 § 1
episodes.description: In today’s episode… Simplicity in the “Little Way” How St. Thérèse had no remarkable events outwardly—or inwardly! How simplicity goes straight to God as both our end and our means

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 24~Ch 8 § 1-2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 24~Ch 8 § 1-2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How St. Thérèse exercised her zeal in two ways: Prayer and Sacrifice How her prayer was usually dry How sacrifice is the very basis of the Redemption

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 23~Ch 8 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 23~Ch 8 § 1
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How Zeal is like a fire The Source of Zeal How Zeal is part of the motto of the Carmelites

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 22~Ch 7 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 22~Ch 7 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About exercising prudence in abandonment Cautions about high aspirations On closing your eyes to the future On not being rash or presumptuous

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 21~Ch 7 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 21~Ch 7 § 1
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How St. Thérèse abandoned herself because she loved and wanted to love still more How confidence, poverty, and littleness are the product of all the virtues and weaknesses of children How abandonment leads to love

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 20~Ch 6 § 2 - Ch 7
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 20~Ch 6 § 2 - Ch 7
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… How suffering may (or may not) be part of the Oblation to Merciful Love How the principal result is the constant exercise of charity How another result is a good death About Holy Abandonment, to have no other will than that of God’s

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 19~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 19~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… That suffering is the “inseparable companion of love” How the soul suffers because it sees God so little loved and gravely offended That there are “Exchanges of Love” which can be made only on the cross That each cross presents itself as a “most efficacious means of purchasing souls for Him”

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 18~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 18~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About offering ourselves to infinite love and how it draws love to us What an oblation to Divine Justice entails What an oblation to Divine Love entails

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 17~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 17~Ch 6 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About the Oblation to Merciful Love How St. Thérèse wanted to love God as she loved him How she wanted to make love her “special vocation” and diffuse it How she wanted to recieve into her heart the Love that sinners disdain

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 16~Ch 6 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 16~Ch 6 § 1
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear about: Her "discovery" of the Divine Lift Surrender to Love Surrender to Providence

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 15~Ch 5 § 3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 15~Ch 5 § 3
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear… About “refinements” of love Of smiling in the face of suffering On asking for external goods in prayer

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 14~Ch 5 § 3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 14~Ch 5 § 3
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear more of what love consists… To strew flowers of little sacrifice To profit from the least opportunities Not to suffer only, but to rejoice!

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 13~Ch 5 § 2-3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 13~Ch 5 § 2-3
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear…. How all the most ardent desires of St. Thérèse tended to love How Divine Charity in us too wants to expand and to grow How love should be the focus at all stages of the spiritual life In what love consists…First, in seeking to give pleasure to God

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 12~Ch 5 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 12~Ch 5 § 1
episodes.description: In today’s episode…. We hear how in this life all is love, all proceeds from love, and all endsin love We see this love in the life of St. Thérèse—in her generosity, her practice of renunciation, and her confidence in God. We also see this love in holy childhood, where nothing is of any worth but to operate in love.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 11~Ch 4 § 3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 11~Ch 4 § 3
episodes.description: In today’s episode we hear about six applications of Confidence in God: In relation to past sins On occasion of daily faults In failures In darkness and dryness (Aridities) In fears concerning the future In desires for holiness (no matter how great)

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 10~Ch 4 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 10~Ch 4 § 2
episodes.description: In today’s episode…. We hear how confidence opens the flood gates of God’s benefits. We learn that what God inspires me to ask for is what He wills to give. And how if we obtain little from God it is because we ask little. We are cautioned about an excess of confidence—the sin of presumption.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 9~Ch 4 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 9~Ch 4 § 1
episodes.description: On today’s episode… The 2nd foundation of Confidence in God—Love of God for us is a merciful love. The 3rd foundation—How God’s Justice rewards good as well as punishes evil.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 8~Ch 4 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 8~Ch 4 § 1
episodes.description: On today’s episode we hear: How one’s helplessness can be a strength since it draws the help of a father. How we can have confidence in this help. About having confidence in God’s love for us.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 7~Ch 3 § 3-5
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 7~Ch 3 § 3-5
episodes.description: On today’s episode we hear: How the truly poor in spirit remains perfectly detached. That we must remain poor for life. How St. Thérèse wished to appear empty handed before God and why. About the forgetting of fellow creatures and placing one’s happiness in being forgotten.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 6~Ch 3 § 1-2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 6~Ch 3 § 1-2
episodes.description: Today we hear about: How the soul who realizes her poverty has but to turn trustfully to God, whose goodness supplies for all. Surest means of lacking nothing is to possess nothing A father only gives to a child what is necessary in the moment (Our daily bread)

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 5~Ch 2 § 2
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 5~Ch 2 § 2
episodes.description: Today we hear about: Rejoicing when we experience our litleness and helplessness. How God loves the least and the weak. How we must always remain little at any age.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 4~Ch 2 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 4~Ch 2 § 1
episodes.description: In this episode, we will break down the first mark of spiritual childhood—the characteristic of being small. Fr. Gabriel invites us to embrace a path where we become 'very, very little' before God, illustrating that this littleness is intrinsically linked to humility. In a detailed reading that spans pages 9 to 11 of the paperback edition, we shall learn that, in the eyes of the divine, we are nothing without His mercy. Importantly, to truly embrace this state of littleness, we must not only perceive ourselves accurately—recognizing both our potentials and our flaws—but also find joy in this r

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 3~Ch 1 § 2-3
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 3~Ch 1 § 2-3
episodes.description: In today's episode, we will delve into Chapter 1, Sections 2 and 3, covering pages 4-8 of the paperback. This session specifically focuses on the qualities we must embody as children of God—embracing our littleness and weakness while wholeheartedly committing ourselves to His divine will.

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 2~Ch 1 § 1
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 2~Ch 1 § 1
episodes.description: In today's episode, we read Chapter 1, Section 1, a reflection about our identity as children of God, shaped by the sacrament of baptism and inviting us to approach our Heavenly Father with the innocence and trust characteristic of a child. The core theme of this reading centers on the concept of spiritual childhood, an aspect of our Christian faith that emphasizes our relationship with God as a loving father. The chapter opens with the certainty that through baptism, we have not only received divine life but have also been welcomed into the family of God. St. John captures this magnificently

episodes.title: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 1~Foreward
episodes.short: The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood: Day 1~Foreward
episodes.description: This month’s book is The “Little Way” of Spiritual Childhood by Fr. Gabriel Martin, a French priest and close confidant of St. Therese's family. He also gave the homilies for both her beatification and her canonization. Fr. Martin's work, written just 26 years after St. Therese's passing, seeks to make accessible her teachings on the “Little Way.” Topics will include: Spiritual Childhood Littleness and Weakness Poverty Confidence in God Love Holy Abandonment Zeal Simplicity

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 28~Conclusion
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 28~Conclusion
episodes.description: In the Book’s concluding podcast, William Wilson summarizes the key teachings of Br. Lawrence: practicing the presence, abandonment, distractions, faith, suffering & sickness, and more. William also previews next month’s book.

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 27~Life: Conclusion
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 27~Life: Conclusion
episodes.description: As we draw nearer to the end of B’r. Lawrence’s life, we witness a man who embraces suffering as a sacred call, transforming pain into a vehicle for divine love. He reflects on his singular desire: to suffer for the love of God. In a remarkable testament to his faith, he chooses to endure the agony of illness with a spirit of gratitude. Even when he experiences sharp, debilitating pain, his fervor for God remains undiminished. He appreciates suffering, stating, “My only uneasiness is that I do not suffer,” demonstrating an extraordinary alignment of his will with the Divine.

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 26~Life: V
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 26~Life: V
episodes.description: The episode further uncovers the physical tribulations that Nicolas faced, particularly his battles with gout and other debilitating illnesses. His acceptance of suffering is shown as he engages in conversations with his physician, revealing his unique perspective on life and death. He notably expressed a poignant sentiment: "Ah, sir, your remedies succeed too well. You have delayed my happiness," demonstrating his longing for divine union over the prolongation of earthly existence. In a world often grappling with the fear of death, Nicolas's attitude serves as a testament to faith’s capacity

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 25~Life: IV
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 25~Life: IV
episodes.description: Brother Lawrence's profound faith anchored his spiritual journey. It was this faith that kindled a burning desire within him to seek God above all, leading him to perceive created things as trivial in comparison to divine love. This faith transcended mere intellectual assent and deepened his reverence for holy mysteries, particularly for the sacrament of the altar, where the unseen presence of Christ reigns. Hope, a vital offshoot of his faith, cultivated in Brother Lawrence a radical trust in God’s mercy and providence. With unwavering confidence, he embraced life's uncertainties, leaning not

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 24~Life: III
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 24~Life: III
episodes.description: Throughout this episode, you will hear about Br. Lawrence’s physical suffering—a painful ulcer on his leg that led to his temporary removal from the kitchen where he had worked diligently for thirty years. But rather than seeing this as a setback, Br. Lawrence viewed this shift in his assignment as an opportunity to deepen his relationship with God.

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 23~Life: II
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 23~Life: II
episodes.description: Brother Lawrence struggled during the early years of his religious life, a span where sorrow and desolation marked his spiritual pursuits. He was said to have no true taste for prayer and experienced nights filled with anguish at the foot of the holy altar—where his faith remained his only support. This testament to fortitude resonates deeply, reminding us of the night faced by saints such as St. John of the Cross. In a pivotal moment, Br. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 21~Letters: 14-16
episodes.description: In the fourteenth letter, Brother Lawrence writes to express his deep concern for Rev. Mother’s prolonged suffering. He encourages her to shift her perspective, seeing her trials as divine tokens of God's love. Rather than seeking relief through human remedies, he advises her to wholly surrender her anguish into the hands of God, trusting that her resignation may bring her healing. Moving to the fifteenth letter, Brother Lawrence shares his own experiences of intense suffering. He discloses that during his tribulations, rather than praying for relief, he sought the strength to endure his pain

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 20~Letters: 11-13
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 20~Letters: 11-13
episodes.description: Brother Lawrence begins his Eleventh Letter to Madame with a heartfelt note on the importance of trusting in God at all times. He emphasizes that confidence in God is essential, especially during moments of loss and suffering. The letter encourages Madame to view her reliance on God as a nurturing friendship, reassuring her that divine love is paramount above all earthly attachments. Moving to the Twelfth Letter, Brother Lawrence shifts focus to the theme of suffering. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 19~Letters: 7-10
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 19~Letters: 7-10
episodes.description: This episode covers Letters 7 through 10: Letter 7: Brother Lawrence begins with an earnest call to seek the invaluable treasures of the gospel. Letter 8: Brother Lawrence extends encouragement to his friends, urging them to cultivate a continual awareness of God. Letter 9: Brother Lawrence addresses a common struggle that many believers face: wandering thoughts during prayer. Letter 10: Brother Lawrence candidly speaks about the essence of life as solely aimed at pleasing God.

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 18~Letter: 6
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 18~Letter: 6
episodes.description: Today you will hear Letter 6, in which Brother Lawrence defends his approach to spiritual practice, emphasizing a life dedicated to the constant awareness of God's presence. Brother Lawrence shares his profound journey, illustrating not only the challenges he faced in the early years of his spiritual quest but also the transformative power of humility and faith. In his communication with a Reverend Father, he confesses that for a decade, he grappled with feelings of inadequacy and concern over his dedication to God. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 17~Letters: 4-5
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 17~Letters: 4-5
episodes.description: The fourth letter, addressed to a Reverend Mother, reveals Brother Lawrence's wisdom on the appropriate use of devotional practices. While acknowledging the importance of these practices as pathways to experiencing God’s presence, he emphasizes that they should not become ends in themselves. Instead, he guides us to focus on maintaining a heart that rests in the Divine, asserting that the true exercise of devotion involves a heartfelt connection with God, free from the constraints of ritualism. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 16~Letters: 2-3
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 16~Letters: 2-3
episodes.description: In the second letter, which we'll read today, Brother Lawrence recounts the sentiments of a “fellow member” of their society, who has dedicated over forty years to religious life. (Really it’s him!) This devout individual exemplifies the essence of practicing the presence of God, illustrating how consistent devotion results in grace. We learn how this person’s soul is perpetually nourished by the divine, often feeling the presence of God so intensely that it manifests as overwhelming joy. However, Brother Lawrence cautions us about our own blindness, urging us to recognize the abundance of God

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 15~Letters: Preface & 1st
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 15~Letters: Preface & 1st
episodes.description: This episode marks a transition as we shift from third-person accounts of Brother Lawrence's spirituality to his own first-person reflections captured in his letters. We begin with the preface, originally penned in 1692, which sets the stage by acknowledging the legacy of the Carmelites and highlighting Brother Lawrence, who humbly sought to avoid the spotlight during his life. The preface describes how, despite his humility, Providence has chosen to spotlight his saintliness posthumously, making his teachings accessible to those yearning for a deeper understanding of divine intimacy. Brother

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 14~Conversation 4
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 14~Conversation 4
episodes.description: In today's episode Brother Lawrence expounds on the act of praising, adoring, and loving God without ceasing, urging us not to be dismayed by our shortcomings. He reassures us that regardless of our failures, God's grace is ever available, provided we remain mindful of His presence. Our sanctification lies not in changing our actions but in performing our daily duties and common tasks for God's glory. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 13~Conversations-2 (cont’d) and 3
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 13~Conversations-2 (cont’d) and 3
episodes.description: In this episode, Brother Lawrence shares that all bodily mortifications hold little value unless they lead to a true union with God. This notion serves as a pivotal theme throughout the conversations; our actions should be rooted in love for God, transforming even the most mundane tasks into opportunities for divine communion. You’ll hear about Brother Lawrence’s contentment in various life situations, illustrating that true peace comes from performing one’s duties for the love of God, irrespective of external circumstances. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 12~Conversations-1 & 2
episodes.description: In today's episode, we delve into Conversation 1 and the first half of Conversation 2—which outlines Brother Lawrence's transformative journey toward understanding God’s providence through the imagery and symbolism of a tree. This tree becomes a pivotal emblem of Brother Lawrence's faith. The podcast begins by setting the stage for Brother Lawrence’s initially awkward yet deeply spiritual existence. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 11~The Gathered Thoughts of Br. Lawrence-Part II
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 11~The Gathered Thoughts of Br. Lawrence-Part II
episodes.description: In today's episode, we delve into the second part of “The Gathered Thoughts of Brother Lawrence,” Brother Lawrence speaks to the insufficiency of human understanding and articulation in grasping the infinite perfection of God. He expresses a yearning that resonates deep within many believers—a desire for a relational experience that transcends mere intellectual knowledge. The narrative emphasizes that it is through faith that we can illuminate our spirits and gain deeper insights into our Creator. episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 10~The Gathered Thoughts of Br. Lawrence-Part I
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 10~The Gathered Thoughts of Br. Lawrence-Part I
episodes.description: Today, we delve into a unique section titled “The Gathered Thoughts of Brother Lawrence”, sourced from a rare 1907 edition of his Spiritual Maxims. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 9~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part V
episodes.description: Today marks Day 9 of The Practice of the Presence of God by Brother Lawrence. We read the concluding section of “The Ways of Brother Lawrence”, focusing on the profound theme of renouncing worldly attachments and emphasizing that this sacred practice is accessible to everyone, transcending the confines of cloistered life.

episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 8~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part IV

episodes.title: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 7~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part III
episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 7~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part III
episodes.description: This episode recounts a poignant moment from Brother Lawrence's life when confronted with a personal disappointment. His ability to accept the authority of his superiors and the outcomes of their decisions speaks volumes about his indifference and trust in God's plan. Listeners will learn of his encounter with a saintly visitor when he was ill, illustrating that his heart was unclouded by earthly attachments, ready to accept whatever God willed. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 6~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part II

episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 5~The Ways of Br. Lawrence-Part I
episodes.description: In this episode, we delve deep into the essence of Brother Lawrence's teachings through the first part of “The Ways of Brother Lawrence,” illuminating his character and insights into a living faith. Brother Lawrence’s doctrine is not merely theoretical; it is a call to engage with God in every moment of our lives. He compels us to weave our duty to worship and love God into our daily actions. The episode showcases how his perspective on faith is illuminated by an unwavering commitment, urging us to run towards God, spurred by an innate love that transcends mere obligation.

episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 4~Spiritual Maxims 5-6

First and foremost, Brother Lawrence emphasizes the importance of leading a life of great purity. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 3~Spiritual Maxims 2-4
episodes.description: In today’s episode, we dive into Day 3 of The Practice of the Presence of God by Brother Lawrence, where we will explore Spiritual Maxims 2-4. We begin with discussion on the essence of worshiping God in spirit and in truth. We are called to confront our own shortcomings and the ways in which we stray from His will. episodes.short: The Practice of the Presence of God: Day 1~Preface
episodes.description: Today is Day One of our exploration of The Practice of the Presence of God by Brother Lawrence. In today's episode, we explore the fundamental themes of Brother Lawrence's teachings, emphasizing the importance of practicing God’s presence in our daily lives. episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 28~Letters
episodes.description: Today, we dive into a special bonus selection from Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade. This episode contains two letters penned by Fr. Caussade. These letters emphasize the extraordinary happiness that arises from a complete surrender to God’s will, offering listeners a rich and reflective conclusion to this month-long engagement with the book.

episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 27~Appendices
episodes.description: This episode reaches a culmination with a series of appendices rich in spiritual exercises and acts of confidence in God's providence. Each prayer encapsulates a response to God's will, urging listeners to embrace a loving union with the divine. We commence with a guided exercise by St. Francis de Sales, encouraging listeners to kneel in humility before God’s inexhaustible goodness. episodes.title: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 26~Appendix 2-3
episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 26~Appendix 2-3
episodes.description: Today, we read Appendices 2 and 3 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade. The first part of our reading, Appendix 2 on Perfect Abandonment, emphasizes the readiness that arises from a complete surrender to God's will. We learn that true liberation comes when we cast off the burdens of self-love and ego, finding ourselves filled entirely with the love of God. In moments of strife and difficulty, this abandonment brings a profound peace that surpasses all understanding, allowing us to navigate our worries and fears with serene confidence in God's fatherly goodness. episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 25~Appendix 1

Jean-Joseph Surin, an esteemed figure of the Society of Jesus in the 17th century. We begin with a brief biography of Fr. Surin, a priest who displayed virtues and resilience amid trials throughout his life. episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 24~Ch 12 (Book 3)
episodes.description: In this episode, we read Chapter 12 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade, marking the conclusion of the original text. episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 23~Ch 10-11 (Book 3)
episodes.description: Today is Day 23 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade. In this episode, Fr. de Caussade guides us through teachings on the dangers of intellect divorced from piety and humility. Chapter 10 begins with a compelling assertion: the faithful soul derives unprecedented strength from humility and submission to the will of God, a stark contrast to the destructive pride that led Lucifer to fall. episodes.title: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 22~Ch 9 (Book 3)
episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 22~Ch 9 (Book 3)
episodes.description: Welcome to Day 22 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade. Today's episode features Chapter 9. In this chapter, we begin with a reflection on wisdom derived from Psalm 110 (Vulgate), which underscores the vital importance of practicing God’s precepts for a deeper understanding and connection to Him. episodes.description: Welcome to Day 21 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade. Today, we delve into chapters 7 and 8, exploring themes of trust, surrender, and the divine workings of God. In Chapter 7, we are encouraged to embrace self-abandonment to God, where justification is found not in our words or actions, but in the divine action itself. episodes.title: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 20~Ch 5-6 (Book 3)
episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 20~Ch 5-6 (Book 3)
episodes.description: In today's episode, we continue our journey through the teachings of Fr. Jean-Pierre de Caussade in his seminal work, Abandonment to Divine Providence. Hosted by William Wilson, this 20th day brings us to Chapters 5 and 6, where we delve into the remarkable themes of trusting in divine action and the pivotal role that our enemies can play in our spiritual growth. Fr. de Caussade presents a striking assertion: he fears not those who oppose him, but rather his own actions and those of his allies. episodes.title: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 19~Ch 3-4 (Book 3)
episodes.short: Abandonment to Divine Providence: Day 19~Ch 3-4 (Book 3)
episodes.description: In today’s episode of the Catholic Audiobook in a Month podcast, William reads chapters 3 and 4 of Abandonment to Divine Providence by Father Jean-Pierre de Caussade. We read about the Night of Faith and these chapters contain the famous metaphor of divine workings within the soul being like the back of a tapestry—a messy, chaotic view that only reveals its beauty when seen from the front. Also, whereas in Day 18 we had mystery, today we have disguises!

Fr. de Caussade begins by illustrating how a soul fully surrendered to God's will often finds itself cloaked in mystery. He notes that as God withdraws light and clarity from our understanding, it is precisely then that He guides us most safely. The author references St. John’s assertion that true knowledge is imparted directly by the Holy Spirit, suggesting that those who are divinely abandoned have a profound intuition of God's will for their lives.
